comments.text: Facts for the good people: Ink pad brand is Shachihata.  Be aware that ink pads come in water-based and oil-based inks (also "chalk" inks) which have different properties and drying times.  You can go over an oil-based stamping with water colour markers or inks.  Making you own stamps using linocut or woodcarving tools is fun.  You can repurpose old erasers to carve or buy carving materials. Etsy is loaded with custom stamps, and I love the tiny German Perlenfischer mini stamps as little icons throughout my journal as a code for particular types of entries or to mark things I can go back to.  Also Trodat and others make text stamps with sets of tiny alphabets that you position with tweezers across the lines of the stamp to make your own name and address or any changeable text message. Some are pre-inked, like the date stamps.  Any good office supplies place sells them. Midori make stamps rolling pads for the date, months, borders, frames, weather etc.
